essence: The twenty-four principles from prakṛti to earth are invoked for purification.
One purifies the gross body with the self-principle.
One purifies the subtle body with the vidyā-principle.
One purifies the supreme body with the supreme śiva-principle.
Every tattva is finally cleansed only by the primordial seed in which all of them are sheltered.
